summary: Independent verifier mapped every TASK-0008 acceptance criterion to current evidence and reran the required checks using the AGENTS.md workstation Python entrypoint.

criteria.criterion: Record writing produces content-addressed local artifact/evidence records with deterministic JSON serialization.

criteria.criterion: Tests prove hash stability, schema validity, and no private thought-chain field is persisted.
criteria.notes: Focused tests cover schema validity, stable/idempotent hashes, evidence attachment without state mutation, and private thought-chain key rejection.

uv run python -B scripts/check.py, uv run python -B scripts/lint_awkp.py, focused unittest, and git diff --check passed. Bare python on this workstation hits the AGENTS.md DocGuard/E-SafeNet launcher issue and is not counted as a project failure.
